input.question: What was the suicide rate of slaves versus that of slave-owners?
input.ground_truth: I just finished a Carribean history class, and we covered this. Way higher among slaves for sure. We didn't cover any slave owner suicides so i doubt they were common at all. as stated in another comment many Africans believed their souls would return home when they died and it was viewed as a way to rejoin their family. Keep in mind slaves came from various parts of Africa and spoke different languages. A lot of people picture slaves immediately forming tight knit communities when they arrived but its much more complicated than that. I'm pretty sure suicide was fairly common in the middle passage and soon after the slaves arrived and diminished the longer they were on the plantation.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: What was the suicide rate of slaves versus that of slave-owners?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay, let’s try to explain this in a very simple way, like I’m talking to a 5-year-old.

Imagine there are two groups of people: one group is made up of people who are made to work without any freedom (these are the slaves), and the other group is made up of people who tell the slaves what to do and have lots of things (these are the slave-owners).

Now, sometimes people in the slave group feel so sad and hopeless that they don’t want to live anymore. We call that “suicide.” The same thing can happen to people in the slave-owner group, but usually, they have more things and feel happier, even though they are doing something very wrong by owning slaves.

Historians have looked at old records and found that slaves had much harder and sadder lives. Because of all the pain and sadness, more slaves wanted to stop living than slave-owners did. So, the “suicide rate” (which means how many people in a group die by suicide) was much higher among slaves than among slave-owners.

But remember, both of these things are very sad, and no one should feel so bad that they want to stop living. The big difference is that slaves were treated very badly, which made them much more likely to feel that way.
